# Singapore MOH Clinical Guidance on Dengue Fever

## Overview and Endemic Risk
Dengue fever is hyperendemic in Singapore with transmission throughout the year across urban housing estates.

## Dengue Warning Signs
Warning signs typically appear around the time of defervescence (days 3 to 7 of illness) and include:
- Severe abdominal pain or persistent vomiting
- Clinical fluid accumulation (pleural effusion, ascites)
- Mucosal bleeding (epistaxis, gingival bleeding)
- Lethargy, restlessness, or altered mental state
- Liver enlargement >2 cm
- Progressive increase in hematocrit concurrent with rapid decrease in platelet count

## Primary Care Escalation
Patients with any dengue warning signs require urgent same-day referral to an Emergency Department or designated acute dengue care center.
